title: RiskTier
description: The T0-T4 internal AI risk tier carried on every call across the Go/Python boundary (ADR-0006 §2.5; ZTAX-AIGOV-001 §5). A request at a tier above its use case's ceiling is refused rather than downgraded: downgrading would let a caller reach a lower-scrutiny path by mislabelling its own request.
$comment: The order of the enum is the order of the tiers. Go: ai.RiskTiers. Python: ztax_gateway.provenance.RiskTier. Both are tested equal to this list.
